checkRuns.command:
cat > src/routes/_layout.kay <<'EOF'
--- server
import { books } from '../content.config'

const [, section, slug, ...rest] = ctx.url.pathname.replace(/\/$/, '').split('/')
// An unknown book slug renders the 404 page under /books, which lights no link.
const inBooks = section === 'books' && rest.length === 0 && (slug === undefined || await books.get(decodeURIComponent(slug)) !== undefined)
---
header
  a(href="/" aria-current={undefined}) Bookshelf
  nav(aria-label="Main")
    a(href="/books" aria-current={inBooks ? 'page' : undefined}) Books
    a(href="/about" aria-current={section === 'about' && slug === undefined ? 'page' : undefined}) About
    a(href="/contact" aria-current={section === 'contact' && slug === undefined ? 'page' : undefined}) Contact
main
  slot
footer © Bookshelf
EOF
bun run fmt && bun run check && bun run build 2>&1 | grep -i 'error\|warn\|route' | head

bun run fmt && bun run check && bun run build >/tmp/build.log 2>&1; echo build=$?; bun test 2>&1 | tail -4; pgrep -f 'bun.*kay start' | xargs -r kill; sleep 1; pgrep -af 'kay start' | grep -v pgrep | grep -c bun
